_: behaviour -> the test(s) that name it. Same shape as kit-hosted.tests.json: the corpus carries the mapping, keyed on file + title (a vitest title is the exact it() string, without its describe() prefix).
_authored: 2026-10-13, by reading kit-ui.beh against the UI's vitest suite (claude-code-bot#105). Only behaviours whose then-steps or main contract a test ASSERTS are mapped; pending ones stay unmapped, so `kit check kit-ui` keeps naming them. BEH-SHEET-1 had no asserting test and got one in the same change.
_honest: A mapping entry is a HUMAN'S CLAIM that the named test asserts the behaviour. kit check proves the test exists, not what it asserts. Several entries cover the contract rather than every then-step (PAIR-1 and STEP-1 do not assert their headings; NAV-1 does not click through).
